record.where: The Darklands table (v3.26 — the scale ladder made honest)

clauses.text: the three-tab ladder with engine exclusivity
THE GREYMARCH (survey sheet) → THE DARKLANDS (the briefing table) → THE KNOWN WORLD
same-bake windowing with the subject framed on real land
The terrain is sampled from the SAME planet bake the globe renders (Globe.elevAt) windowed around the Greymarch pin — one truth about the world
painted-density floor (thousands of samples: bone/gold/sea all present)
a stippled grey-blue sea (a surface, never a hole)

figure.note: the best one-second window of three seconds with the table running holds 20 frames or more
the check asserts the record's own floor of 20 frames a second, not 60

clauses.text: its light coverage as gold stipple that grows with S.cov, station pips (lit gold / dark grey) that scale as the table is leaned into, rust rings on un-quieted camps, the walker a white pulse
The uncharted region pins live on this table — the recon system's future ground drawn where it will happen
The canvas now carries padding past the halo (PADF 0.26) so the atmosphere ends where IT ends — corners verified empty, glow verified alive between disc and edge

figure.note: the canvas side is at least 2.5 disc radii (0.26 gives 2.52); the pad factor itself is not read

clauses.text: the caption owns the new station
the farthest the glass pulls back · an ornament of the survey, for now

design.what: the plain names: the tabs read Valley · Region · World and the windows Map, Region map, World map — the Greymarch, the Darklands and the Known World ride under them as subtitles
